headline: Public hearings on parking permits, variances, and additions for four properties, including 319 Hunt Street and 488-494 Dexter Street.
summary: Four zoning applications will be discussed, and the board may vote on them. They involve parking permits, building additions, and open area rules.
items: Application PZB-2026-08Z: Juan Rodriguez seeks special-use permits for fewer off-street parking spaces than required and for off-site parking at 488-494 Dexter Street (Plat 6, Lot 344).

Application PZB-2026-09Z: Effuahson, LLC seeks a use variance and dimensional variances to build an addition to an existing garage at 319 Hunt Street (Assessor's Plat 3, Lot 121). The requests cover the expansion of a legal nonconforming use, rear-yard setbacks, maximum lot coverage, and total open area of less than 800 square feet.
Application PZB-2026-10Z: Elie Osko seeks dimensional variances from minimum parking aisle width requirements to build a 2-story addition to a home at 42-44 West Hunt Street (Plat 7, Lot 123).
Application PZB-2026-11Z: Balwant Sandhu seeks a dimensional variance to permit a total open area of less than 800 square feet at 40-42 Fletcher Street (Plat 5, Lot 301).
location: The Bessette Building (DPW), 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
plain_text:
CITY OF CENTRAL FALLS 
                 COMBINED PLANNING AND ZONING BOARD 
 
 
Page 1 of 2 
REGULAR MEETING 
(PUBLIC HEARING) 
Wednesday, August 26, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863 
 
AGENDA 
I. Call to Order 
II. Roll Call 
III. Pledge of Allegiance 
IV. Approval of Minutes 
A.  Regular Meeting Minutes of July 22, 2026 
V. Public Comment 
VI. New Business 
A.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Zoning Board, discussion and possible votes on 
      Application PZB-2026-08Z: 
Juan Rodriguez, of 901 Roosevelt Ave, Pawtucket, RI, Applicant for 488 -494 Dexter Street 
(Plat 6, Lot 344) seeks Special-Use Permits to provide fewer than the minimum number of off-
street parking spaces required and to provide off-site parking (Art. V, Sec. 514.13(b)-(c)). 
B.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Zoning Board, discussion and possible votes on 
      Application PZB-2026-09Z: 
Effuahson, LLC, of 40 Toronto Avenue, Providence, RI, represented by Jones Harris, Applicant 
for 319 Hunt Street (Assessor's Plat 3, Lot 121), proposes to construct an addition to the 
existing principal garage. The Applicant seeks a Use Variance to expand the legal 
nonconforming use and Dimensional Variances from rear-yard setback requirements (Art. IV, 
Sec. 401, R-3 Zone), maximum lot coverage requirements (Art. IV, Sec. 401, R -3 Zone), and 
from the requirements of Art. IV, Sec. 401.1(B) to permit a total open area of less than 800 
square feet on the subject property. 
C.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Zoning Board, discussion and possible votes on 
      Application PZB-2026-10Z: 
Elie Osko, of 6 Cook Street, Lincoln, RI, Owner and Applicant for 42-44 West Hunt Street (Plat 
7, Lot 123), proposes to construct a 2 -story addition to the existing principal residence. The 
Applicant seeks Dimensional Variances from minimum parking aisle width requirements (Art. 
VIII, Sec. 801.2, 90-Degree Angle). 
D.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Zoning Board, discussion and possible votes on 
      Application PZB-2026-11Z:
Page 2 of 2 
Balwant Sandhu, of 4 Bartlett Road, Methuen, MA, Owner and Applicant for 40 -42 Fletcher 
Street (Plat 5, Lot 301) seeks a Dimensional Variance from the requirements of Art. IV, Sec. 
401.1(B), to permit a total open area of less than 800 square feet on the subject property. 
VII. Adjournment 
Pursuant to Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-4, the Board reserves the right to convene in executive session on any of the aforementioned items 
for one or more of the purposes listed in Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-5(1)-(10).
